fixes.explanation: Not quite, friend. Joseph says the opposite to the cupbearer: “…I have done nothing for which they should have put me in this dungeon.” (Genesis 40:15) He also says he was kidnapped from the land of the Hebrews. So Joseph is telling the cupbearer he didn't earn that dungeon.

No servants in this dream, friend. The baker says the top basket held all sorts of baked goods for Pharaoh, “…but the birds were eating them out of the basket on my head.” (Genesis 40:17) Birds, with a basket sitting on a man's head, helping themselves. That's the rudest buffet I ever heard of! I'd be waving my mustache and hollering, and I bet the birds would ignore me and keep right on eating.
